snippet.title: Operation Wishmaker // Looker's Confidential Report (Pokémon Starwish Teaser)
snippet.description:
VOICES
Boss - @EndeRxfteR 
Aven - @FrainbreezeN1 
Rhea - @NikiBThatsMe  
Kael - @EliteOmegaZeroX

I wasn’t supposed to find this.
One corrupted data shard buried in ZamSon’s main server… and it opened a door I can’t close.

I decrypted the footage.
Four silhouettes.
Four voices.
And the way they spoke—calm, practiced, absolute—
It felt less like a briefing and more like a prophecy.

Aven’s precision chilled me.
Rhea’s tone… like she was studying fate itself.
Kael radiated the kind of confidence only true danger has.
And their “Boss”…
I’ve never heard conviction sharpened into something so cold.

If the League knew what I heard tonight, they wouldn’t sleep.
Truth is… I’m not sure I will either.

This isn’t just another group of criminals.
This is something intentional.
Something inevitable.

And Hoenn has no idea what’s coming.
This briefing is only the beginning.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A fan-made Hoenn RPG—the first classic-style project with FULL VOICE ACTING—is on the horizon.

Join the cause on Discord:
https://discord.gg/2f8JwnM49G
#pokemonfangame #pokemonstarwish
